opportunities.title: Research Awards (Research and Travel Grants)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be from the project director or principal investigator. Awards not made for work contributing to an undergraduate or postgraduate degree; retrospective applications not considered. Early career researchers welcome.
opportunities.summary: Annual project grants of £500 to £5,000 to support research into the human past through its material culture or material remains, across archaeology, art history, architectural and buildings history, material culture, and the history of collecting. Named awards (Marion Wilson, Joan Pye, Hugh Chapman) are made within this scheme.

opportunities.summary: Named research fund within the Society's Research and Travel Grants programme, supporting research into the material past (Britain pre-1800 focus).

opportunities.title: William and Jane Morris Church Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: No references required; applicants must upload supporting documents such as photographs, architect/conservation reports or budgets.
opportunities.summary: Grants for the conservation of church interiors and monuments, with two application rounds per year (31 March and 31 August).
